Autonomous Software Engineering Agents: Build AI agents that can independently  explore codebases, understand requirements, plan implementations, and execute  multi-file code changes with minimal human intervention. Intelligent Code Review and Refactoring: Automated analysis of pull requests, identification of code smells, security vulnerabilities, and performance issues with suggested fixes across entire repositories. Codebase Migration and Modernization: Migrate legacy codebases to modern frameworks, upgrade dependencies, and refactor outdated patterns while  maintaining business logic and test coverage. Technical Debt Reduction: Systematically identify, prioritize, and remediate technical debt including improving documentation, adding missing tests, and resolving TODO comments. Multi-Repository Operations: Execute coordinated changes across microservices architectures, update shared libraries, and maintain consistency across polyglot codebases. Interactive Development Assistance: Power advanced IDE integrations and CLI  tools (like Mistral Vibe) that provide context-aware code generation, debugging assistance, and architectural guidance. Automated Test Generation: Generate comprehensive unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end test suites based on existing code and requirements. Documentation Generation and Maintenance: Create and update technical documentation, API references, README files, and code comments synchronized with codebase changes. Bug  Localization and Fixing: Analyze error logs, stack traces, and bug reports to identify root causes and generate patches across multiple files. Code  Translation Between Languages: Translate implementations from one programming language to another while preserving  functionality and maintaining idiomatic patterns
